bead.title: Publish container image coordinates from release workflow
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The release workflow publishes binary release assets but does not build or push the deployment container image, so deployment-ready releases lack image coordinates and digest evidence.

ROOT CAUSE: `.github/workflows/release.yml:14` grants only `contents: write`, and `.github/workflows/release.yml:73` through `.github/workflows/release.yml:86` only package binaries and upload `target/release-dist/*`. `Dockerfile:35` through `Dockerfile:47` defines the runtime image entrypoint, but no release workflow step publishes it.

PROPOSED FIX: Add release workflow steps and any supporting `scripts/release/**` verification helpers to build the existing `Dockerfile`, authenticate to the chosen registry, push immutable version/SHA tags, and write image coordinates plus digest evidence into `target/release-dist` for checksum/upload. Preserve the existing binary archive path and release gate ordering.

GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: Parent bead `pqueue-3546063c`; `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md`; current `v0.1.0` release behavior in `.github/workflows/release.yml` and `scripts/release/package-binaries.sh`.

DEPENDENCY IDS: none supplied by parent.

NON-SCOPE: Creating a tag or GitHub release in this bead; final release execution is a separate bead.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestReleaseWorkflowPublishesContainerDigest: release workflow definitions include a container build/push path for the pqueue service image, registry permissions/auth, immutable version/SHA tags, and a digest/coordinate evidence file under `target/release-dist`.
2. TestContainerPublishingEvidenceChecksummed: the release artifact checksum path includes the image digest evidence file without removing existing binary checksums.
3. TestReleaseGateOrderingPreserved: existing `bash scripts/ci/release-gate.sh --require-tp002-evidence E0,E1,E2,E3 --tp002-e0e1-source pqueue-7e2b3132 --tp002-e2-source pqueue-9afd88cc,pqueue-76d92a33 --tp002-e3-source pqueue-b1abd895,pqueue-472a09d4` remains before artifact publishing in `.github/workflows/release.yml`.
4. TestQualityGates: `go test ./...` and `lefthook run pre-commit` pass from the repository root alongside the workflow/static checks above.
